command:
find /work/crate/src -type f
find /work/crate/tests -maxdepth 2 -type f
cat /work/crate/rust-toolchain* 2>/dev/null
ls /target

cd /work/crate
RUSTUP_AUTO_INSTALL=0 CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=2 cargo test --locked --features sync,future > /work/tmp/baseline.log 2>&1 &
pid=$!
echo "$pid" > /work/tmp/baseline.pid
wait "$pid"

cd /work/crate
RUSTUP_AUTO_INSTALL=0 CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=2 cargo test --locked --features sync,future --lib --tests -- --test-threads=2 > /work/tmp/tests.log 2>&1

grep -n 'async fn insert_with_hash\|compute_with_hash\|async fn insert\|async fn invalidate' /work/crate/src/future/cache.rs /work/crate/src/future/base_cache.rs
sed -n '1820,2110p' /work/crate/src/future/cache.rs
sed -n '300,530p' /work/crate/src/future/base_cache.rs
sed -n '1,210p' /work/crate/src/future.rs

grep -n 'is_dirty\|set_policy_gen\|entry_gen()' /work/crate/src/sync/base_cache.rs /work/crate/src/future/base_cache.rs
grep -n '^test result' /work/tmp/tests.log
sed -n '1410,1750p' /work/crate/src/sync/base_cache.rs
sed -n '2350,2550p' /work/crate/src/sync/base_cache.rs
sed -n '1,150p' /work/crate/src/common/concurrent/constants.rs

grep -n 'is_write_order_queue_enabled\|fn invalidate_all\|pub fn run_pending_tasks' /work/crate/src/sync/base_cache.rs /work/crate/src/sync/cache.rs
sed -n '1910,2050p' /work/crate/src/sync/base_cache.rs
sed -n '2180,2280p' /work/crate/src/sync/base_cache.rs
sed -n '265,450p' /work/crate/src/common/timer_wheel.rs
sed -n '180,340p' /work/crate/src/common/concurrent/deques.rs
